title: T300 Printer Project roadmap
summary: Recovery-first path from stock printer to audited mainline candidate, then print-quality commissioning.

milestones.title: Owner sign-off on candidate design
milestones.summary: Review Dossier, migration guide, safety UI audit, Orca contract, and release gates before physical migration.

milestones.title: Recovery USB and full stock backup
milestones.summary: Boot recovery, identify hardware, capture and verify eMMC image, and prove rollback path.

milestones.title: USB-boot mainline candidate with printer control disabled
milestones.summary: Validate screen, services, camera, storage, network, and permissions without motion or heat.

milestones.title: Attended hardware commissioning
milestones.summary: Owner initiates sensor, fan, endstop, probe, axis, heater, MCU-loss, and emergency-stop tests.

milestones.title: Print-quality baseline
milestones.summary: Run standard first-layer, dimensional print, camera bracket, and calibrated filament tests before Frieren.
